# Copilot Instructions

## Code Documentation Standard
- All public and protected classes and methods must be documented using proper XML documentation comments. 
  - XML comments must always use full sentence form, including correct capitalization and punctuation, and must clearly describe the purpose, behavior, parameters, return values, and exceptions of the documented member.
- Inline comments inside method bodies must be written in lowercase, must not be full sentences, and should be used only to clarify non-obvious implementation details. 
  - Inline comments must remain concise and must not duplicate information already expressed through XML documentation.
